title: Ask naturally.
Answer precisely.
Stay connected.
intro: Turn scattered company documents into a knowledge hub that answers questions with sources you can check.
sceneCaption: Interface concept · Not an actual product screenshot
screenAlt: A paper-textured Synaiq KIP knowledge-search concept showing a question, answer and source from a fictional equipment purchasing process
sampleQuestion: How do I request a laptop for a new colleague?
sampleAnswer: Request details: purpose, specs and budget.
sampleHighlight: After manager approval, Purchasing gets quotes and orders. Inspect on arrival.
steps: PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, scans, handwriting and images—all in one place.
Read the content, reconstruct tables and follow processing progress.
Ask in your own words, then check the original document.
layers: Web, APIs and mobile devices connect to existing workflows.
Choose a model for your needs and connect questions to organizational knowledge.
Bring in documents, parse them and organize source collections.
Permissions, records, image search and reports support everyday use.
proofCopy: Intelligent Knowledge Search (IKS) links questions to documents. Knowledge Center (KC) handles ingestion, parsing and collections.
Answers and sources appear together, so every search can be checked.
capabilities: Connect to your existing enterprise systems.
Grant access by data scope and role.
Keep usage records and conversation history.
Find images with text, or similar images with an image.
Understand usage and keep improving your knowledge content.
